//: This file configures the WALLET deployment. Vercel always prefers vercel.json over dashboard settings, and a repository can only have one — so it belongs to the wallet, which is the deployment that needs the security headers. The docs project is configured through its dashboard instead; the equivalent settings are kept in deploy/vercel-docs.json for reference.
buildCommand: npm run standalone && mkdir -p public && cp standalone/veyra-sign.html standalone/veyra-watch.html standalone/SHA256SUMS standalone/VERIFY.md public/ && cp standalone/veyra.html public/index.html

headers.value: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
